subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) The country was having problems regarding the practice of slavery. (b) Abraham bincoln was born in 1809 in Kentucky, USA (c) Blacks were brought from Africa to work on these farms and they were kept as slaves. (d) The white men owned large farms in the Southern States. (e) He wanted to solve the problem of slavery. (f) At this difficult time, Abraham Lincoln was elected president of the USA in 1860. (g) In 1862 lincoln declared that from the onwards all slaves would be free. (h) Finally a civil war broke out between the northern and the southern states and he fought the war bravely and declared 'A nation cannot exist half free and half slave'.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
